calibration.verdict: All 30 fixed A/B takes passed human listening without an obvious quality difference
calibration.rationale: Threshold 0.12 accepts every human-approved 10-step take (observed max CER 0.1053), while rejecting the 20-step mixed-language ASR outlier at CER 0.2105 for escalation. It yields one false retry among 30 human-approved samples and remains bounded by the 30-step final attempt.
